MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 2

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

3. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 5

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 25

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 12

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
